programme.title: We Love Millionaires / 我愛金龜婿

programme.title: The Kid with the Golden Arm / 金臂童
programme.desc: The government hires Yang to escort a cargo of gold to a famine stricken area. programme.title: West Chamber / 西廂記
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. programme.title: Crocodile River / 鱷魚河
